jobs.description: Project Manager EMEA (Stuttgart, Germany)Why Joining De NoraDe Nora is an Italian multinational company and a global leader in electrochemical technologies. Since 1923, we've been developing advanced solutions for industrial processes, water treatment, and the energy transition, including green hydrogen, transforming scientific innovation into real-world, scalable impact. We value learning, innovation, and professional growth, offering our professionals the opportunity to work on meaningful, high-tech projects with global relevance. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, guided by sustainability, collaboration, and respect, where different backgrounds, skills, and perspectives are valued.About the roleAs part of the Integrated Water Solutions business segment within De Nora's Water Technologies, you will be based in Stuttgart, Germany, and lead industrial water and wastewater projects from contract award through to successful handover. You will coordinate multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in line with contractual and technical requirements.Key ResponsibilitiesProject Coordination & Stakeholder Management- Manage all project stakeholders and interfaces across clients, engineering, procurement, construction, and subcontractors- Act as main point of contact for clients and ensure clear, transparent communicationProject Cost Control & Contract Management- Own and drive project financial performance, ensuring achievement of gross margin targets- Develop and control budgets, monitor costs, and implement corrective actions when needed- Identify risks and opportunities and manage contract/claim processes- Perform change management at project level helping individuals understand, internalize and support a changeProject & Resource Planning- Lead project planning, scheduling, and resource allocation- Ensure on-time delivery through effective monitoring and coordinationTechnical Project Management- Coordinate engineering activities and ensure efficient workload distribution- Participate in technical meetings and ensure compliance with contractual and technical requirementsQuality, Safety & Site Execution- Ensure HSE compliance and coordinate site execution activities- Oversee construction and commissioning to ensure quality and contractual compliance- Ensure successful system handover to the clientProject Monitoring & Reporting- Track project progress, performance, and KPIs- Provide clear reporting and drive continuous project improvementsRequirements- Degree in Engineering or comparable technical qualification- Extended experience in project management of industrial plant projects (€1–10M), including parallel projects- Strong expertise in budgeting, cost control, and resource planning- Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills incl. leading project teams (5+ people)- Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented working style- Experience in risk and contract management- Ability to work with technical drawings and documentation- Proficient in MS Office and project tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera)- Fluent in English and German- Willingness to travel (EMEA)- Valid driver’s license B- EPC and/or pipeline construction experience is a plusWhat we offer- Your well-being matters – benefit from a flexible health budget you can use for preventive medical check-ups, glasses, professional dental cleanings, and more.- Your future is important to us – we support your long-term financial security with a company pension scheme (betriebliche Altersvorsorge) and up to 20% employer contribution.- Your everyday life should be easier – enjoy access to a Corporate Benefits program with exclusive discounts and special offers across a wide range of shops, brands, and products.- Stay mobile and sustainable – with our company bike leasing program, you can easily lease your dream bike while promoting your health and protecting the environment.Your health is important to us – that’s why we continue to support you financially beyond the statutory 6 weeks in case of illness.Kindly ensure that all application documents are submitted in English.Recruiting ProcessOur selection process is designed to foster mutual understanding between the candidate and De Nora. It typically includes technical interviews, and in-depth discussions with the Hiring Manager and HR, promoting a dialogue that supports alignment on expectations, role scope, and values, and enables an informed decision for both parties.To learn more about the different steps and how to best prepare, please read the dedicated article on our Open Blog: Job interview at De Nora (https://open.denora.com/en/job-interview-de-nora) .About Us- Our Company: Dive into De Nora’s World (https://denora.com/en/about-de-nora)- Our three business segments: Solutions (https://denora.com/en)  | De Nora- Our People: OPEN by De Nora (https://open.denora.com/en) | Surprising pathsÜbersetzung des AG:Projektmanager EMEA (Stuttgart, Deutschland)HauptaufgabenProjektkoordination & Stakeholder Management - Koordination aller Stakeholder-Projekte sowie der Schnittstellen zwischen Kunden, Engineering, Einkauf, Bauausführung und Subunternehmen. - Übernahme der Funktion als zentraler Ansprechpartner für Kunden sowie Sicherstellung einer klaren und transparenten Kommunikation. Projektkostenkontrolle & Vertragsmanagement - Verantwortung für die finanzielle Entwicklung und Wirtschaftlichkeit der Projekte sowie Sicherstellung der Erreichung der angestrebten Bruttomargen. - Erstellung und Überwachung von Projektbudgets, Kontrolle der Kosten sowie Einleitung von Korrekturmaßnahmen bei Bedarf. - Identifikation von Risiken und Chancen sowie Steuerung von Vertrags- und Nachtragsmanagementprozessen. - Durchführung von Change-Management-Maßnahmen auf Projektebene, um die Beteiligten dabei zu unterstützen, Veränderungen zu verstehen, anzunehmen und aktiv mitzutragen. Projekt- und Ressourcenplanung - Verantwortung für die Projekt- und Terminplanung und Zuweisung von Ressourcen. - Sicherstellung der termingerechten Projektabwicklung durch eine effektive Überwachung und Koordination. Technisches Projektmanagement - Koordination der technischen Planungs- und Entwicklungsaktivitäten sowie Sicherstellung einer effizienten Arbeitsverteilung. - Teilnahme an technischen Besprechungen und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung vertraglicher und technischer Anforderungen.Qualität, Sicherung und Bauausführung - Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Gesundheits-, Sicherheits- und Umweltschutzvorschriften (HSE) sowie der Koordination der Arbeiten vor Ort. - Überwachung der Bauausführung und Inbetriebnahme, um die Einhaltung der Qualitätsstandards und vertraglichen Anforderungen sicherzustellen. - Sicherstellung einer erfolgreichen Übergabe der Anlagen an die Kunden. Projektüberwachung und Reporting - Überwachung des Projektfortschritts, der Projektleistung sowie relevanter KPIs. - Erstellung transparenter und aussagekräftiger Projektberichte sowie Förderung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Projektabläufen. Voraussetzungen - Abgeschlossenes Studium im Ingenieurwesen oder vergleichbare technische Qualifikation- Mehrjährige, umfassende Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, von industriellen Anlagebauprojekten mit einem Projektvolumen von 1 bis 10 Millionen Euro, einschließlich der gleichzeitigen Betreuung mehrere Projekte. - Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Budgetplanung, Kostenkontrolle und Ressourceplanung.- Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Kompetenzen, einschließlich der Erfahrung in der Leistung von Projektteams mit mindestens fünf Mitarbeitenden.- Strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. - Erfahrung im Risiko- und Vertragsmanagement. - Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen und Dokumentationen zu verstehen und damit zu arbeiten. - Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office sowie Projektmanagement-Tools (z.B. MS Project, Primavera).- Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. - Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen innerhalb der EMEA-Regionen.- Gültiger Führerschein der Klasse B. - Erfahrung in EPC und/oder im Rohrleitungsbau ist ein Plus.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Change-ManagementExpertenkenntnisse: Projektmanagement, Terminplanung, -überwachung

jobs.occupation: Clinical Customer Development Specialist (m/f/d) – Infectiology (Referent/in - Klinische Studien (CRA))
jobs.description: Job available in 4 locations: Berlin, Halle, Remote, LeipzigWork ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionJob DescriptionAs part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.Location:Field-based / Remote within the territory - Eastern/ Central GermanyIdeally based in e.g. Halle, Leipzig or BerlinDiscover Impactful WorkJoin our Clinical Customer Development team as a Clinical Customer Development Specialist and support the targeted clinical use of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.In this field-based role, you will lead clinical market development across your territory and increase awareness, acceptance and sustainable adoption of our biomarkers through targeted engagement with healthcare professionals, clinical education and development activities. In doing so, you will support the diagnosis and management of bacterial infections and sepsis, as well as antimicrobial stewardship initiatives, and contribute to advancing biomarker-guided clinical decision-making.You will take ownership of clinical market development within your territory, with the goal of increasing demand, acceptance and sustainable clinical adoption of our biomarkers. Your focus will be on clinical education, stakeholder engagement and account development, while commercial contracting and sales execution remain with our License Partners.A Day in the Life:You will lead clinical account development across hospitals and healthcare institutions within your territory and build strong, sustainable relationships with clinicians, laboratory professionals and healthcare decision-makers in areas such as Internal Medicine, Paediatrics, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, Critical Care and Antimicrobial Stewardship teams.You will identify the objectives and clinical challenges of healthcare professionals and translate these insights into targeted educational and development activities. This includes supporting the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs, as well as delivering clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.What to expect:- Drive clinical demand and adoption of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.- Engage healthcare professionals, clinical users and decision-makers across relevant medical specialties.- Analyze and prioritize accounts with high clinical development potential, identify relevant stakeholders and develop account-specific strategies to increase clinical acceptance and adoption.- Build strong, sustainable relationships with key clinical stakeholders and decision-makers.- Support the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs.- Deliver clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.- Develop account strategies together with our License Partners, align clinical development activities and support joint customer activities where appropriate.- Act as a scientific and clinical partner and actively drive market development without direct sales responsibility.- Work closely with Medical Affairs, Marketing and other Commercial teams.- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at relevant events and scientific congresses.- Contribute to territory growth through increased clinical adoption and systematic account development.Ensure complete and up-to-date documentation of relevant account and activity information in Salesforce (SFDC).Keys to Success:Education- Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology or a related scientific field; an advanced scientific or clinical degree is an advantage.Experience- 3+ years of relevant experience in healthcare, diagnostics or a related environment.- Experience in in vitro diagnostics, biomarkers, or clinical areas such as Critical Care, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, sepsis or Antimicrobial Stewardship is an advantage.- Experience engaging clinical users and healthcare decision-makers.Knowledge, Skills, Abilities- Ability to understand and communicate scientific and clinical content.- Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.- Confident and persuasive engagement with medical decision-makers at different seniority levels, with the ability to conduct credible clinical discussions, constructively challenge established approaches and initiate change.- Strong analytical and organizational capabilities.- Strong initiative, influencing skills and results orientation, with the ability to identify clinical development opportunities early and systematically advance them.- Ability to build lasting relationships with clinical stakeholders and business partners.- Ability to work independently and effectively in a cross-functional matrix organization.- Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, and Microsoft Office.- Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory (>50%).- Fluent German and strong English communication skills.Benefits:We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com/)Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of  , color, religion, ___ ,   orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.
